segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בּוֹלֶשֶׁת שֶׁנִּכְנְסָה לְעִיר, בִּשְׁעַת שָׁלוֹם — חָבִיּוֹת פְּתוּחוֹת אֲסוּרוֹת, סְתוּמוֹת מוּתָּרוֹת; בִּשְׁעַת מִלְחָמָה — אֵלּוּ וְאֵלּוּ מוּתָּרוֹת, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין פְּנַאי לְנַסֵּךְ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «a military unit [boleshet] that entered a city,» if it entered «during peacetime,» then after the soldiers leave the «open barrels» of wine «are forbidden,» but the «sealed» barrels «are permitted.» If the unit entered «in wartime,» both «these» barrels «and those» barrels «are permitted, because» in wartime «there is no time to pour» wine for «libations,» and one can be certain that the soldiers did not do so.

moves.summary: peacetime vs wartime rule for barrels

positions.claim: in peacetime open barrels are forbidden and sealed permitted; in wartime both are permitted
positions.basis: no time to pour libations in wartime
